tweets.text: The flight attendant and pilot on @Delta flight 4985 were nothing short of amazing. Super kind, helpful, and funny. Wish they were my crew every time I fly!
@116468 Hi Kyle, thanks for recognizing our employees. We're proud of our crew too. Every day our team is working to make flying with us better! *TMB

Hey @Delta how are you going to charge me to move to an earlier flight, not move my luggage to my flight and THEN tell me you can’t deliver my luggage b/c I ‘voluntarily separated’ from it?! I didn’t ‘voluntarily’ leave my bag. 🤷🏼‍♀️
@116469 Hi Kelli. I truly regret the frustration we've caused you. Please contact our Baggage Service Center at 800-325-8224 and are open from 7:00 AM - 1:00 AM.  *TKR
I’m sure delivering my bag would be a lot less than the $10k+ I’ve spend with your airline each year for the past 10+ years @delta. Just a guess though. 🤷🏼‍♀️
